bio: Can the flavours of the world be discovered all in one place? Here, in an environment of unique volcanic landscapes, they say they can, because they fuse their Latin American roots (chef Rubén Darío Rivera is from Colombia) with Canary Island products and make subtle culinary nods to other cultures. The menu, which always includes very interesting proposals (ask about the grilled local fish), is supported by two solid tasting menus: Ruta compartida and Experiencia Citurna.
